name: ai-editorial-team
description: A coordinated editorial team for research, writing, art direction, publishing preparation, and final editorial quality control.

displayDescription.en: An editor-in-chief coordinates research, writing, art direction, and publishing specialists to turn ideas and materials into complete editorial deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 由主编统筹研究、写作与设计三个角色协作，从事实核查、结构表达、视觉方案到最终交付形成完整编辑工作流。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Organize the editorial team and turn my materials into a complete publishable article.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 组织编辑部，把我的想法或资料做成一篇完整可发布的文章。

quickPrompts.en: Organize the editorial team and turn my materials into a complete publishable article.
quickPrompts.zh: 组织编辑部，把我的想法或资料做成一篇完整可发布的文章。

quickPrompts.en: Research this topic, write the article, and propose a visual direction.
quickPrompts.zh: 研究这个选题，完成文章，并给出完整的视觉设计方向。

quickPrompts.en: Have the full editorial team review and improve my current draft.
quickPrompts.zh: 让整个编辑部评审并完善我现在这篇草稿。

profession.zh: 资料研究与事实核查编辑
